MECHANISM: sell-side models built through the FY25 Juniper-close stub period were discounting networking as an integration drag (visible in the +8.32% dilution and 4.36x leverage that priced the deal); Morgan Stanley's note explicitly reframes that same business as a higher-margin growth driver -- consensus was modeling the acquisition cost, not the payoff. RESOLUTION: the fiscal Q3 FY2026 print due 2026-09-03 against the raised $11.5-12.1B guide is the first dated data point that tells us whether the margin-recovery read behind today's upgrade is real.
